newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market at standstill - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market at standstill - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet, with no sales slaughter steers or heifers confirmed, USDA said. Inquiry was fair and demand light.

Week-to-date including late Friday and over the weekend 1,000 head confirmed. Last sales Friday, Feb 14, Select and Choice steers and heifers 64.00. Monday's asking prices mostly 66.00, bids few 63.00.
Confirmed - none last week - none last year - none
week to date - 1,000 last week - 5,700 last year - 7,800
